item.title: Python execfile Replacement: Effective Methods for Executing Files in Python 3
item.description:
“Python execfile Replacement: Effective Methods for Executing Files in Python 3”

The execfile() built-in function, a staple in Python 2, is absent in Python 3. Developers encountering this function in older codebases or documentation need appropriate substitutes to execute arbitrary Python code from a file within their running script. What are the primary, effective, and context-aware ways to replicate or supersede the behavior of execfile() in Python 3 environments?

Simple Direct Execution Substitutes

The most immediate replacements focus on reading the file content and passing it to the standard exec() function.
